After five years of working perfectly, my Balay washing machine has broken down. I requested a repair quote and was told it would be around €160 including VAT (parts and labor, but they couldn't give me an exact figure because if the repair takes more than half an hour, the cost increases per minute). When the technician arrived, he told me it would be about €100 more, claiming that whoever spoke to me on the phone made a mistake and gave me the wrong quote. I asked him to check, and he said I was right, that they had given me the price of a similar part over the phone, but not the one we needed, even though they had the reference number we required because they had already made an initial visit. Therefore, the technician (whom I don't blame) left without repairing the appliance. He said that they would obviously call me to explain, but that hasn't happened. I'm going to have to buy a new washing machine, as the repair costs almost more than buying a new one.

Extremely disappointed with the quality of the appliances and the complete lack of empathy from the technical service.
I have several Balay appliances at home, and my experience with the brand has turned into a major disappointment. This is the second microwave of the same model that has failed me in the same way: it literally exploded from the inside before even reaching three years of use.

The serious issue isn't just this dangerous and recurring failure, but the response from customer service: they inflexibly cling to the purchase date to wash their hands of the matter, completely ignoring when the utilities were activated or when the appliance was actually put into use. They don't care that you're a loyal customer who trusts the brand and even pays for extended warranties on other products, given the results you've gotten.

They sell you an image of quality and guarantees that, when it comes down to it, translates into appliances that fail and after-sales service that leaves you stranded. I don't intend to have the appliance repaired on their behalf, and of course, I won't trust them for future purchases. A complete disappointment.

one_star_reviews.text:
UPDATE TO MY REVIEW: After learning how the purchase actually turned out, I completely retract my initial positive review.

Before I finalized the order, they were incredibly rushed. They told me I absolutely had to come immediately because if I took more than a day, the price would go up.

I placed the order and paid 60% of the sofa's price on January 5th. They assured me the delivery time would be 60 days. However, the sofa didn't arrive until April 27th, approximately 112 days after I had ordered it and made a partial payment.

What's most infuriating is that, despite having significantly missed the delivery deadline, when it finally arrived, they were the ones who pressured me: either I paid the remaining amount immediately or they couldn't deliver it.

Furthermore, the sofa I received isn't as comfortable as the one we tried in the showroom. Given this discrepancy, we returned to the store three times to compare them, and the conclusion is clear: the sofa they delivered is considerably firmer than the model we tested and whose comfort influenced our purchase decision.

To make matters worse, the order arrived incomplete. Two cushions that were specifically included were missing. They weren't delivered until September 19th, more than eight months after I placed the order.

In short, a lot of pressure to close the sale and collect payment, but unjustifiable delays, an incomplete order, and a sofa whose comfort doesn't match that of the model we tested in the showroom. A very different experience from our initial impression, and absolutely disappointing after-sales service. I do not recommend buying from them.

Last week I went in looking for a high-end leather sofa, but the saleswoman was so busy with other customers that she didn't even speak to me. In the end, I bought it at another store where I received proper service.

one_star_reviews.text:
I've been a member of this association for many years, and during all that time, I've brought quite a few friends with me. I've always had a good relationship with the association and several of the staff members, which is precisely why it pains me to have to write a review like this.

About two weeks ago, I cancelled my membership after having a problem with the same woman who helped me today. Even so, since I had a good relationship with the association and it seemed a shame to stop being a member, I decided to rejoin.

Today I returned, and to my surprise, the same person treated me even worse. In front of a lot of people, while I was trying to explain the situation and clear things up, she told me I couldn't be in the club and that I should leave, all in a very rude manner.

I said, "Wait a second, we need to clear things up." Even so, she insisted I leave. I told her I was going back right away to get my ID, and when I returned, she simply opened the door for me to leave, without even giving me a chance to talk.

I completely understand that there are rules and procedures to follow. I have no problem with that. What I do have a problem with is the way things were handled. After so many years as a member and having a good relationship with the association, I believe I deserved, at the very least, respectful treatment.

And the most ironic thing is that just today I had six friends waiting to become members. Obviously, after seeing the way I was treated, none of them are going to become members. It's not that I expect six new members to change the association's situation, but I think it says a lot about how one bad experience can end up affecting more people.

I also want to make it clear that I know there are other staff members who are very good and who have always treated me well. My criticism isn't directed at them. That's precisely why it saddens me so much that one person's behavior has led me, after so many years, to cancel my membership again for good.

And, as she herself would say, "Honey, you have to be more polite." Well, that's exactly it. I believe that a minimum of courtesy and respect should be applied to everyone.

I'm leaving quite disappointed, especially since I decided to rejoin precisely because I felt bad about leaving the association and because I had a good relationship with them. It's a shame that a situation like this ended up completely changing my opinion.

THE WORST SCRAPYARD WE'VE EVER BEEN TO. We're a mechanic's workshop, so we've been to practically every scrapyard in the Murcia region and part of Alicante.
We've never seen anything like this. They cheat on the prices, telling you one thing and then another. They send you photos of the part with a price, and then when you arrive, they tell you that you have to add X amount if you want the complete part, even though it was already ordered complete with its price. I had to go three times, a total of 500 km, for a part that I ended up taking home incomplete because they wanted to charge me 50 euros more. Needless to say, I will never return to this scrapyard, and of course, when customers ask me for recommendations on scrapyards to find their parts, I will tell them not to go to this place. A total disgrace. I'm sure they'll send the typical copy-and-paste response of "we regret your situation..." Things are solved by treating customers well from the very beginning, not by apologizing later. It's a shame I didn't read the negative reviews earlier, which are quite a few; maybe it's time to review staff or policies.

one_star_reviews.text: Lots of rice and very little fish. They're laughing at people. They put a child in charge of making the nigiri, and he makes them better (than they're supposed to be).

Extremely expensive, especially since there were four of us and you can order 20 dishes per round. For the first round, we only received 10 dishes. We ordered a second time, hoping for what we'd ordered. Only 4 dishes arrived. For the third round, we ordered just one dish, which arrived ice cold, as if it had just come from the refrigerator (see photo). We didn't even touch it. I'd run an all-you-can-eat buffet like this too: if you have rounds, and you order and the food doesn't arrive, plus the drinks are so expensive, it's no wonder this place is so popular. My rating: 0. Never again... One final note: the girl cleaning the table couldn't have been less enthusiastic. A second waiter had to come and clean it again because it was almost exactly as the previous diners had left it.

Another time, a month after buying it, I wanted to change the case, and the back glass cracked, and now the screen has come unglued. It only lasted a year for the €600 I spent. The battery health drops the very day you buy it. The quality is awful, and it's very expensive for that kind of thing to happen. I don't recommend buying refurbished phones here.
